jobPositions.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobPositions.description:
Senior Software Engineer - Full Stack

Location: San Francisco, CA (Hybrid)
Contract Type: Full-time employment
Experience Level: 5+ years
English: Fluent

About the Role
We are seeking a talented Senior Software Engineer to join our innovative engineering team at Tech Innovations Inc. In this role, you'll work on cutting-edge full-stack applications, lead technical discussions, and help shape the future of our products. This is a hybrid position with 3 days in our San Francisco office.

Responsibilities
• Design, develop, and maintain scalable full-stack applications using modern technologies
• Lead technical discussions, code reviews, and architectural decisions
• Mentor junior and mid-level engineers, fostering a culture of continuous learning
• Collaborate with product managers, designers, and other stakeholders to deliver high-quality features
• Implement best practices for testing, deployment, and monitoring
• Contribute to technical documentation and knowledge sharing

Requirements
• 5+ years of professional software development experience
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field (or equivalent experience)
• Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, React, and Node.js
• Experience with PostgreSQL or other relational databases
• Solid understanding of software architecture patterns and best practices
• Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail
• Excellent communication and collaboration skills

Nice to Have
• Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or other containerization technologies
• Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure)
• Experience with microservices architecture
• Previous experience mentoring or leading technical teams
• Contributions to open-source projects

What We Offer
• Competitive salary range: $80,000 - $120,000 per year
• Comprehensive health insurance (medical, dental, vision)
• 401(k) matching program
• Flexible PTO policy
• Hybrid work arrangement with remote work options
• Professional development budget for conferences and courses
• Modern office with standing desks and collaborative spaces
• Stock options in a fast-growing company
• Regular team events and company outings

jobPositions.title: Frontend Developer
jobPositions.description:
Frontend Developer - React Specialist

Location: New York, NY (Remote)
Contract Type: Full-time employment
Experience Level: 3+ years
English: Intermediate to Advanced

About the Role
We're looking for a passionate Frontend Developer with strong React expertise to join our product team. You'll be responsible for building beautiful, responsive, and performant user interfaces for our web applications. This is a fully remote position with occasional team meetups in New York.

Responsibilities
• Build and maintain modern, responsive web applications using React and TypeScript
• Implement pixel-perfect designs from Figma mockups with attention to detail
• Optimize application performance and ensure cross-browser compatibility
• Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code
• Collaborate with backend engineers to integrate RESTful APIs
• Participate in code reviews and contribute to frontend architecture decisions
• Stay up-to-date with the latest frontend technologies and best practices

Requirements
• 3+ years of professional experience with React and modern JavaScript
• Strong proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, and responsive design principles
• Experience with state management libraries (Redux, Context API, Zustand, or Jotai)
• Familiarity with modern build tools (Webpack, Vite, etc.)
• Understanding of RESTful API integration and asynchronous programming
• Experience with Git version control and collaborative development workflows
• Good problem-solving skills and attention to UI/UX details

Nice to Have
• Experience with TypeScript in production applications
• Knowledge of testing frameworks (Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress)
• Familiarity with Material-UI or other component libraries
• Understanding of web accessibility standards (WCAG)
• Experience with performance optimization techniques
• Previous work with design systems or component libraries

What We Offer
• Salary range: $60,000 - $90,000 per year
• 100% remote work with flexible hours
• Comprehensive health insurance
• Remote work stipend for home office setup
• Professional development budget for online courses and conferences
• Unlimited PTO and sick leave
• Annual company retreat
• Modern tech stack and tools
• Supportive and collaborative team culture

jobPositions.title: DevOps Engineer
jobPositions.description:
DevOps Engineer - Cloud Infrastructure Specialist

Location: Austin, TX (Remote)
Contract Type: Contract position (hourly)
Experience Level: Senior (5+ years)
English: Fluent

About the Role
Digital Solutions Corp is seeking an experienced DevOps Engineer to design, implement, and maintain our cloud infrastructure. You'll work with cutting-edge technologies to build scalable, reliable, and secure systems that power our applications. This is a fully remote contract position with opportunities for long-term engagement.

Responsibilities
• Design and implement cloud infrastructure solutions on AWS, GCP, or Azure
• Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using modern DevOps tools
• Automate infrastructure provisioning using Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar tools
• Monitor system performance, troubleshoot issues, and ensure high availability
• Implement security best practices and compliance requirements
• Collaborate with development teams to optimize application deployment processes
• Document infrastructure architecture and operational procedures
• Participate in on-call rotation for production support

Requirements
• 5+ years of professional DevOps or Site Reliability Engineering experience
• Strong expertise in cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure)
• Proficiency with containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes)
• Experience with infrastructure as code tools (Terraform, Ansible, CloudFormation)
• Solid understanding of CI/CD concepts and tools (Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions)
• Strong scripting skills in Python, Bash, or similar languages
• Knowledge of monitoring and logging tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack)
• Experience with version control systems (Git)

Nice to Have
• Certifications in cloud platforms (AWS Solutions Architect, GCP Professional, etc.)
• Experience with service mesh technologies (Istio, Linkerd)
• Knowledge of database administration (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB)
• Familiarity with agile development methodologies
• Experience with security scanning and vulnerability management tools
• Previous work in a high-availability, mission-critical environment

What We Offer
• Competitive hourly rate: $70 - $100 per hour
• 100% remote work with flexible schedule
• Opportunity to work with modern cloud technologies
• Collaborative team environment with experienced engineers
• Project bonuses for successful infrastructure improvements
• Long-term contract opportunity with potential for conversion to full-time
• Access to cloud training resources and certifications
requirements: Expert knowledge in Python and SQL

jobPositions.title: Product Manager
jobPositions.description:
Senior Product Manager - Digital Products

Location: Seattle, WA (Hybrid)
Contract Type: Full-time employment
Experience Level: 5+ years
English: Fluent (required for stakeholder communication)

About the Role
We are seeking an experienced Product Manager to lead the strategy, development, and launch of our digital products. You'll work cross-functionally with engineering, design, marketing, and customer success teams to deliver innovative solutions that solve real customer problems. This hybrid role requires 2-3 days per week in our Seattle office.

Responsibilities
• Define and communicate product vision, strategy, and roadmap aligned with business goals
• Conduct user research, competitive analysis, and market validation
• Write clear product requirements and user stories for engineering teams
• Prioritize features and manage the product backlog using agile methodologies
• Work closely with engineering and design teams throughout the development lifecycle
• Analyze product metrics, user feedback, and KPIs to inform product decisions
• Lead product launches, including go-to-market planning and stakeholder communication
• Present product updates and strategic recommendations to senior leadership
• Champion customer needs and ensure exceptional user experience

Requirements
• 5+ years of product management experience, preferably in B2B SaaS or digital products
• Proven track record of successfully launching and scaling products
• Strong analytical skills with experience using data to drive product decisions
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills
• Experience with agile development methodologies (Scrum, Kanban)
• Proficiency with product management tools (Jira, Asana, Productboard, etc.)
• Understanding of UX/UI principles and design thinking
• Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, or related field

Nice to Have
• MBA or advanced degree in relevant field
• Technical background or engineering experience
• Experience with A/B testing and growth experimentation
• Familiarity with SQL and analytics tools (Mixpanel, Amplitude, Google Analytics)
• Previous experience in a fast-paced startup environment
• Product management certifications (CSPO, CPO, etc.)
• Experience managing API products or developer-focused products

What We Offer
• Competitive salary range: $90,000 - $140,000 per year
• Equity/stock options with significant upside potential
• Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
• 401(k) matching program (up to 6%)
• Unlimited PTO policy
• Hybrid work arrangement (2-3 days in office)
• Professional development budget for courses, conferences, and certifications
• Modern office in downtown Seattle with great amenities
• Collaborative culture with smart, passionate teammates
• Opportunity to shape product strategy and make real impact
requirements: Proven track record of launching successful products
responsibilities: Work with engineering and design teams

feedback.content: It would be great to have bulk candidate import from LinkedIn. This would save us a lot of time when sourcing candidates.
The interview scheduling feature is not syncing correctly with Google Calendar. Sometimes events disappear after 24 hours.
Love the new analytics dashboard! The visualizations are very helpful for tracking our hiring metrics.
Could you add support for video interview integrations? We use Zoom and Microsoft Teams extensively.
The application form builder is intuitive and easy to use. Great job on the UX!
Email templates sometimes don't save properly when using special characters. Getting a 500 error.
